items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; taps ~0.25-0.4s nudge, holds 1-2s travel (~2s shifts world ~100px; character stays screen-center). Space = contextual action. LMB hover/select shows verb label; clicking targets does nothing useful. Escape = Paused menu (Continue ~(0.31,0.58)); pause freezes world. Craft UI open does NOT pause time (durability/night damage tick). Tab = map (assumed, untested this run).

PICKING (observed): 'Pick X' only appears when close and roughly same y; farther reads 'Examine X'. Space with only Examine fails silently. Standing on the target flips Pick to Examine; step off or back a fraction. Confirmed yields: sapling -> Twigs x1; grass tuft -> Cut Grass x1; yellow flower -> Petals x1. A berry bush area produced Berries in hotbar (mechanism uncertain: picking bush vs proximity/automatic). Picked saplings reappear as bare saplings that show 'Examine Sapling' even when adjacent = depleted, not pickable. No-verb scenery: ground sticks/twigs, small sprigs, dead saplings, red mushrooms (pickability untested), rabbit holes ('Examine Rabbit Hole'), redbirds/butterflies/critters, rocks (purple rock seen, no harvest verb observed).

HOTBAR: fills in acquisition order; hover a slot icon to read name/count; approximate slot centers x 0.135, 0.20, 0.26, 0.32 at y~0.93. CRITICAL: green icons are not all Cut Grass — Petals look similar; always hover-verify counts. In this run slot tooltips frequently failed to render, leaving counts unreadable.

CRAFT UI (observed): left sidebar icons at x~0.019, tools/axe ~y0.114, flame 'Light' ~y0.197. Clicking flame opens vertical recipe column x~0.05-0.15, rows y~0.13, 0.22, 0.30, 0.375, 0.45. Documented behavior from an earlier run: hovering a row center x~0.10 opens a right detail panel (name, costs as have/need, description, Build button ~(0.28,0.66)); Build may need a second click. Dark tiles = unaffordable silhouettes, bright = affordable. THIS RUN (uncertain): hover and click on the top Light tile (torch silhouette) repeatedly produced no panel and no craft, even in daylight, and hovering hotbar slots also failed to show tooltips; at night all Light tiles appeared dark. Guess: unaffordable tiles give no panel/action; alternatively hover must land exactly on the tile glyph, or one click only selects. Assumed costs: Torch = 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs ('portable light source'); Campfire = 3 Cut Grass + 2 Logs; Fire Pit = rocks + 12 unidentified material. Unknown: identity of bottom bright tile, column scrolling, recipes unlocking from logs/rocks.

TORCH: crafting puts it in hand with % durability (~96 start, ~12% per action cycle, ~8 actions). Lit torch in daylight is wasted. Craft spares before dusk.

NIGHT: dusk message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.'; then near-total blackness 'It's so dark!' with periodic 'OW! Something hit me!' until death. Blue circular icon appears beside the Day clock at night (function unknown). Previously a daylight-held lit torch survived Night 1.

HUNGER: 'I'm so hungry!' warning seen. Petals hover shows 'Eat'; berries likely edible too. Food mechanics unresolved.

FAILED/WASTEFUL: click-to-harvest; Space out of range; standing on target; hovering tree trunks (steals hover from tufts at bases); chasing tufts occluded by pines; treating ground twigs/sprigs as pickable; clicking recipe tile edges; leaving crafting until dusk; assuming all green hotbar icons are Cut Grass; wandering in darkness; retrying a failing UI hover/click during daylight (burned critical gathering time).

LESSONS/HYPOTHESES: daylight is a hard deadline — gather immediately, verify counts by hover, craft well before dusk. Night without a lit torch is fatal. The failed night craft was likely short of materials (probably 1 Twig, possibly 1 Grass), never confirmed because the detail panel never rendered; a sapling gives only 1 Twig, so 2+ saplings are needed for a torch. Gather a surplus (3+ Cut Grass, 3+ Twigs) to guarantee affordability and don't depend on tooltips appearing. Open questions: berries/petals as food, mushroom pickability, blue night icon, whether craft tiles need pixel-precise hover or a select-then-Build click, recipe column scrolling.
